criteria.name: Non-text Content
criteria.testMethod: axe detects missing alt. SR verifies alt quality — navigate images with FIND_NEXT_IMAGE and check announcements are meaningful, not redundant or placeholder text.

criteria.name: Audio-only and Video-only (Prerecorded)
criteria.testMethod: Manual. Check if audio-only content has a text transcript and video-only content has either a text alternative or audio description.

criteria.name: Captions (Prerecorded)
criteria.testMethod: axe checks for caption track presence. Manual review needed to verify caption accuracy and synchronization.

criteria.name: Audio Description or Media Alternative (Prerecorded)
criteria.testMethod: Manual. Check if prerecorded video has audio description or a full text alternative.

criteria.name: Info and Relationships
criteria.testMethod: axe catches structural markup issues. SR verifies: heading hierarchy (FIND_NEXT_HEADING loop), landmark structure (FIND_NEXT_LANDMARK loop), table header associations, form field labels, and list semantics.

criteria.name: Meaningful Sequence
criteria.testMethod: SR walk entire page with next commands from GO_TO_BEGINNING. Check transcript for logical reading order — does the sequence match visual layout intent?

criteria.name: Sensory Characteristics
criteria.testMethod: Manual. Check that instructions don't rely solely on shape, color, size, visual location, orientation, or sound (e.g., 'click the round button' or 'see the sidebar').

criteria.name: Use of Color
criteria.testMethod: axe checks link-in-text contrast. Visual review of screenshots for color-only information: status indicators, error states, required fields, chart data. Each needs a non-color alternative.

criteria.name: Audio Control
criteria.testMethod: Manual. If audio plays automatically for >3 seconds, check for mechanism to pause/stop or control volume independently from system volume.

criteria.name: Keyboard
criteria.testMethod: Tab through entire page. Verify all interactive elements are reachable and operable via keyboard. Test custom widgets with expected keyboard patterns (arrows for tabs/menus, Space/Enter for buttons, Escape for dialogs).

criteria.name: No Keyboard Trap
criteria.testMethod: Tab through entire page including into modals, embedded content, and custom widgets. Verify you can always Tab or Escape out. Check iframes and media players especially.

criteria.name: Character Key Shortcuts
criteria.testMethod: Check for single-character keyboard shortcuts. If present, verify they can be turned off, remapped, or are only active on focus.

criteria.name: Timing Adjustable
criteria.testMethod: axe catches meta refresh. Manual check for session timeouts, auto-advancing content, or time limits — user must be able to turn off, adjust, or extend.

criteria.name: Pause, Stop, Hide
criteria.testMethod: axe catches blink/marquee. Visual review for auto-updating content, animations, carousels, or moving content that starts automatically and lasts >5 seconds — must have pause/stop/hide mechanism.

criteria.name: Three Flashes or Below Threshold
criteria.testMethod: Visual review for flashing content. No content should flash more than 3 times per second unless below general flash and red flash thresholds.

criteria.name: Bypass Blocks
criteria.testMethod: axe checks for skip nav or landmark structure. SR verify: Tab first from page top — is there a skip-to-content link? Check landmarks with FIND_NEXT_LANDMARK.

criteria.name: Page Titled
criteria.testMethod: axe checks title presence. SR announces page title on load — verify it's descriptive and unique.

criteria.name: Focus Order
criteria.testMethod: Tab through page and check focus order matches logical reading/visual order. Pay attention to modals (focus should be trapped inside), dynamic content, and positive tabindex values.

criteria.name: Link Purpose (In Context)
criteria.testMethod: axe catches empty links. SR navigate links with FIND_NEXT_LINK — check each link's announced text is meaningful in context. Flag 'click here', 'read more', 'learn more' without context.

criteria.name: Pointer Gestures
criteria.testMethod: Manual. Check that multipoint or path-based gestures (pinch, swipe, drag) have single-pointer alternatives unless essential.

criteria.name: Pointer Cancellation
criteria.testMethod: Manual. For single-pointer actions: down-event doesn't trigger action (or can be aborted/undone), and up-event reversal is possible.

criteria.name: Label in Name
criteria.testMethod: axe detects mismatches. SR check: for each interactive element, does the accessible name contain the visible text label? Screenshot cross-reference helps.

criteria.name: Motion Actuation
criteria.testMethod: Manual. Check that device motion or user motion-triggered actions (shake, tilt) have UI alternatives and can be disabled.

criteria.name: Language of Page
criteria.testMethod: axe checks html lang attribute presence and validity.

criteria.name: On Focus
criteria.testMethod: Tab through all interactive elements. Verify that receiving focus alone does not trigger a change of context (page navigation, form submission, focus move, significant content change).

criteria.name: On Input
criteria.testMethod: Change values in form controls (select dropdowns, checkboxes, radio buttons, text fields). Verify no unexpected context changes unless user is advised beforehand.

criteria.name: Consistent Help
criteria.testMethod: Manual. If help mechanisms (contact info, chat, FAQ link) appear on multiple pages, verify they are in the same relative order on each page.

criteria.name: Error Identification
criteria.testMethod: Submit forms with invalid/empty data. SR check: are errors announced? Are error messages associated with the relevant fields? Tab to errored fields — does SR announce the error?

criteria.name: Labels or Instructions
criteria.testMethod: axe catches multiple labels. SR tab through form fields — each input should announce its label. Check that required fields, expected formats, and constraints are communicated.

criteria.name: Redundant Entry
criteria.testMethod: Manual. In multi-step processes, check that previously entered information is auto-populated or available for selection — users should not have to re-enter the same data.

criteria.name: Name, Role, Value
criteria.testMethod: axe catches ARIA misuse and missing names. SR verify custom widgets: are role, name, and state changes announced? Check accordions (expanded/collapsed), tabs (selected), checkboxes (checked), dialogs (role + name).

criteria.name: Captions (Live)
criteria.testMethod: Manual. Check if live audio content in synchronized media has real-time captions.

criteria.name: Audio Description (Prerecorded)
criteria.testMethod: Manual. Check if prerecorded video has audio description for visual-only information.

criteria.name: Orientation
criteria.testMethod: Manual. Content should not restrict display to a single orientation (portrait or landscape) unless essential.

criteria.name: Identify Input Purpose
criteria.testMethod: axe checks autocomplete attribute validity. Check that common input fields (name, email, phone, address) have appropriate autocomplete attributes.

criteria.name: Contrast (Minimum)
criteria.testMethod: axe catches most text contrast issues. Visual review of screenshots for text on images, gradients, or dynamic backgrounds that axe may miss. Minimum 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text.

criteria.name: Resize Text
criteria.testMethod: axe checks meta viewport scaling restrictions. Manual: zoom to 200% and verify text is readable, not clipped, and functionality is preserved.

criteria.name: Images of Text
criteria.testMethod: Visual review of screenshots. Check that text is rendered as actual text, not images. Exceptions: logos, decorative text where presentation is essential.

criteria.name: Reflow
criteria.testMethod: Resize viewport to 320px width. Screenshot and verify no horizontal scrolling, no content clipping, no overlapping. Exceptions: maps, diagrams, data tables, toolbars.

criteria.name: Non-text Contrast
criteria.testMethod: Visual review. UI components (form field borders, buttons, icons) and graphical objects need 3:1 contrast against adjacent colors. Check focus indicators, custom checkboxes, icon buttons.

criteria.name: Text Spacing
criteria.testMethod: axe checks for inline spacing overrides. Inject WCAG text spacing overrides (line-height 1.5, letter-spacing 0.12em, word-spacing 0.16em, paragraph spacing 2em) and screenshot — no content loss or overlap.

criteria.name: Content on Hover or Focus
criteria.testMethod: Trigger tooltips and popovers via hover/focus. Check: dismissible (Escape), hoverable (can mouse into the popup), persistent (stays until dismissed). Screenshot to verify.

criteria.name: Multiple Ways
criteria.testMethod: Manual. Check for at least two ways to reach the page: navigation menu, search, sitemap, table of contents, links from related pages.

criteria.name: Headings and Labels
criteria.testMethod: axe catches empty headings. SR navigate all headings with FIND_NEXT_HEADING — each should be descriptive. Check form labels are clear and describe the expected input.

criteria.name: Focus Visible
criteria.testMethod: Tab through interactive elements, taking screenshots at each stop. Check that every focused element has a visible focus indicator distinguishable from the unfocused state.

criteria.name: Focus Not Obscured (Minimum)
criteria.testMethod: Tab through interactive elements with sticky headers/footers, cookie banners, or floating UI present. Screenshot at each stop — the focused element must not be fully hidden behind overlapping content.

criteria.name: Dragging Movements
criteria.testMethod: Manual. Check that drag-and-drop actions (sortable lists, sliders, map panning) have single-pointer alternatives (buttons, text input) unless dragging is essential.

criteria.name: Target Size (Minimum)
criteria.testMethod: axe checks target size. Interactive targets should be at least 24x24 CSS pixels, or have sufficient spacing. Exceptions: inline text links, user-agent-controlled elements, legally required layouts.

criteria.name: Language of Parts
criteria.testMethod: axe checks lang attribute validity. Manual check that content in a different language from the page default has appropriate lang attributes on the containing element.

criteria.name: Consistent Navigation
criteria.testMethod: Manual. Navigation mechanisms repeated across pages should appear in the same relative order each time. Requires testing multiple pages.

criteria.name: Consistent Identification
criteria.testMethod: Manual. Components with the same functionality across pages should be identified consistently (same labels, icons, alt text). Requires testing multiple pages.

criteria.name: Error Suggestion
criteria.testMethod: Trigger form errors. Check that error messages suggest how to fix the problem (not just 'invalid input' but 'enter a valid email address'). SR verify error suggestions are announced.

criteria.name: Error Prevention (Legal, Financial, Data)
criteria.testMethod: Manual. For legal commitments, financial transactions, or user data modifications: check for reversibility (undo), verification (review before submit), or confirmation (confirm dialog).

criteria.name: Accessible Authentication (Minimum)
criteria.testMethod: Manual. Authentication should not require cognitive function tests (puzzles, memorizing passwords) unless an alternative is provided, a mechanism assists the user, or it's object/content recognition.

criteria.name: Status Messages
criteria.testMethod: Trigger status messages (form success, search results count, error banners, loading indicators). SR check: are they announced without focus moving? Check for role=status, role=alert, aria-live regions.
